title: What Drives Compositional Generalization in Visual Generative Models? The Importance of Continuous Training Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2510.03075v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Compositional generalization, the ability to generate novel combinations of known concepts, is a key ingredient for visual generative models. Yet, not all mechanisms that enable or inhibit it are fully understood. In this work, we conduct a systematic study of which design choices critically determine compositional generalization in image and video generation. By isolating independent design axes, we identify two key factors strongly associated with compositional success: (i) whether the training objective operates on a discrete or continuous distribution, and (ii) the completeness of conditioning information about constituent factors during training. We also show that relaxing the discrete loss with an auxiliary continuous latent objective can partially recover compositional performance in discrete models like MaskGIT. Our findings, corroborated by diverse compositional tasks and preliminary evidence in world models and LLMs,

translated_title: 是什么驱动了视觉生成模型中的组合泛化？连续训练目标的重要性
translated_abstract: 组合泛化，即生成已知概念新颖组合的能力，是视觉生成模型的关键要素。然而，并非所有能够促进或抑制这种能力的机制都已被充分理解。在这项工作中，我们对哪些设计选择对图像和视频生成中的组合泛化起决定性作用进行了系统性研究。通过分离独立的设计维度，我们识别出两个与组合成功密切相关的关键因素：(i) 训练目标是作用于离散分布还是连续分布，以及 (ii) 训练期间关于组成因素的条件信息的完整性。我们还证明，通过辅助的连续潜在目标来放宽离散损失，可以在 MaskGIT 等离散模型中部分恢复组合性能。我们的发现得到了多种组合任务的验证，并获得了来自世界模型和大语言模型的初步证据支持。
tldr: 该研究系统性地发现训练目标作用于离散还是连续分布、以及条件信息的完整性是决定视觉生成模型组合泛化能力的关键因素，并证明引入辅助连续训练目标可以在 MaskGIT 等离散模型中部分恢复组合泛化性能。
